metadata.author: Money Making Juggernaut
metadata.shortDescription:
Want to learn how to build and scale your own Surplus Funds business the right way? 🚀

Fill out the inquiry form below to see if you qualify to join my private community — where we do 6 live calls per week for an entire year and help you get your business fully set up the right way.

👉 Apply here: https://www.moneymakingjug.com/inquiry

If you’re not ready for that yet, join my FREE Facebook community with thousands of people in the asset recovery space:

👉 https://www.facebook.com/groups/assetrecovery

And if you want the CRM, automations, dialer, and marketing system we use to run our operation, request a demo of Excess Elite here:

👉 https://excesselite.com

Let’s build. 💰

-------------------------------------------------------
In this training, I walk you through one of the most common and profitable scenarios in the surplus funds business: deceased claims. If you're in the asset recovery business or just getting started with surplus funds recovery, mastering deceased claims is non-negotiable. These are the cases you’ll encounter most often, and they offer the highest potential fees - because most heirs have no idea this money even exists!

We break down how to verify if a previous property owner is deceased, how to find heirs using skip tracing, obituaries, and public tools like Legacy.com and VitalCheck, and the exact steps to structure your outreach with empathy and professionalism. I also cover probate, summary administration, affidavit of heirship, and how to navigate state-specific intestate succession laws.

Whether you're running an asset recovery agency, starting your unclaimed funds business, or looking to expand your knowledge with a surplus funds course - this call gives you the strategy, tools, and legal insights to win with deceased claims recovery.
-------------------------------------------------------
My name is Eric, and on this channel, I teach people how to start a surplus funds business. I also share my journey about running multiple side hustles that have made me financially independent. If you want to follow along and learn how to make smart investments and start super-profitable side hustles, consider subscribing.

Follow me on IG: https://www.instagram.com/erizzyy/

#assetrecovery #surplusfunds #unclaimedfunds
